name: Frank's Strawberries, Sweet Corn and Vegetable Barn
tagline: Frank's Strawberries, Sweet Corn & Vegetable Barn, Carthage, NC
description: Frank's Strawberries, Sweet Corn and Vegetable Barn is a independent farm in Carthage, NC. It grows Strawberries, Squash, Corn, Tomatoes, and Green beans, with seasonal availability through spring and summer. The harvest is typically at its peak in spring. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
